Priya Sharma: quick post-all-hands ask: leadership wants concrete target windows for API, Console UX, and Optimize. can owners + blockers be listed here (we'll mark as "targets")?

Marco Valdez: draft targets: API canary 2024-05-17 -> GA late May; Console beta (flags) 2024-06-08 -> GA late June; Optimize alpha (suggestions) 2024-07-02 -> pilot 2024-07-09. gated by quant infra + SLOs.

Alice Chen: Console owner: Alice Chen. need flags + admin toggles by 2024-06-01 to allow pilot flips. will post checklist tomorrow.

Sofia Rivas: Optimize owner: Sofia Rivas. alpha scope = suggestion engine + UI heatmap, no billing or autoscale. we need 3 pilots and target acceptance > 20%.

Dana Liu: SRE gating: SLOs + canary traffic profiles locked by 2024-05-03. if missed, push canary. Marco, can you co-author?

Marco Valdez: yes, i'll co-author SLOs with Dana and post in #eng-sre by 2024-04-29. also will prepare canary runbook.

Evan Park: platform needs expected qps + replica counts per region by 2024-04-28 to reserve staging capacity. i'll drop a template in #eng-platform.

Ben Ortiz: comms: i'll prepare webinar slide text with qualifiers and hold publish until either API canary starts or Console flags are live.

infra-bot: staging reservation queued: api-canary-gpu 2024-05-01 03:00 UTC :rocket:

Priya Sharma: great 12 please confirm owners/blockers here by EOD so i can finalize the webinar note.
